trusted_channel_ingress_filtering_enable.title: Trusted Channel Ingress Filtering Enabled
trusted_channel_ingress_filtering_enable.description: Indicates whether ingress filtering is applied consistently to all channels including those designated as trusted, with no carve-outs or exceptions that exempt trusted channels from inspection.

trusted_channel_types_defined.title: Defined Trusted Channel Types
trusted_channel_types_defined.description: List of channel types that have been designated as trusted within the environment (e.g., management_interface, backup_agent, replication_link, monitoring_agent).

trusted_channel_bypass_scope.title: Trusted Channel Filtering Bypass Scope
trusted_channel_bypass_scope.description: Describes the scope of ingress filtering bypass for trusted channels — whether all trusted channels bypass filtering, only some do, or none bypass filtering.

unmonitored_egress_ports_present.title: Unmonitored Egress Ports Present
unmonitored_egress_ports_present.description: Indicates whether one or more secondary or legacy communication ports exist on the local storage zone boundary that lack egress monitoring or alerting coverage.

egress_filter_enforcement_mode.title: Egress Filter Enforcement Mode
egress_filter_enforcement_mode.description: The enforcement posture of egress filtering controls at the local storage zone boundary — whether filtering is enforced (blocking), passive (alerting only), or absent.

legacy_ports_in_use.title: Legacy or Secondary Ports In Use
legacy_ports_in_use.description: List of port numbers or service identifiers corresponding to secondary or legacy communication paths currently active on the local storage zone boundary.

internal_subzone_acl_enforced.title: Internal Subzone ACL Enforced
internal_subzone_acl_enforced.description: Indicates whether access control lists or permission boundaries are enforced between internal subzones within the local storage zone.

subzone_isolation_mechanism.title: Subzone Isolation Mechanism
subzone_isolation_mechanism.description: The type of isolation mechanism implemented between internal storage subzones.

cross_subzone_traversal_logged.title: Cross-Subzone Traversal Logged
cross_subzone_traversal_logged.description: Indicates whether access events that traverse between internal subzones are captured in audit or monitoring logs.

session_token_revalidation_at_boundary.title: Session Token Re-Validation at Zone Boundary
session_token_revalidation_at_boundary.description: Whether session tokens or trust attributes carried by cross-boundary processes are re-evaluated and re-issued at the local storage zone ingress point, rather than inherited from the external zone.

cross_zone_trust_inheritance_allowed.title: Cross-Zone Trust Attribute Inheritance Allowed
cross_zone_trust_inheritance_allowed.description: Whether processes originating from the external zone are permitted to retain and use trust attributes inside the local storage zone without re-evaluation.

boundary_ingress_monitoring_coverage.title: Boundary Ingress Monitoring Coverage
boundary_ingress_monitoring_coverage.description: The extent to which ingress points into the local storage zone are monitored and logged for session token, trust attribute propagation, and zone-crossing events.

credential_scope_isolation_enforced.title: Credential Scope Isolation Enforced
credential_scope_isolation_enforced.description: Whether credentials are scoped exclusively to a single trust zone and cannot authenticate across zone boundaries, and whether zone boundary credential reuse has been detected.

shared_credential_store_across_zones.title: Shared Credential Store Across Zones
shared_credential_store_across_zones.description: Whether a single credential store is used to authenticate both external-zone and local-storage-zone access without zone-specific restrictions.

zone_boundary_credential_reuse_detected.title: Zone Boundary Credential Reuse Detected
zone_boundary_credential_reuse_detected.description: Whether audit logs, access records, or configuration analysis confirm that the same credential has been used or is capable of authenticating in both the external zone and the local storage zone.

protocol_translation_points_monitored.title: Protocol Translation Points Monitored
protocol_translation_points_monitored.description: Indicates whether monitoring/logging agents are deployed at points where network-layer traffic is translated to file-system or inter-process communication.

zone_crossing_alert_coverage.title: Zone Crossing Alert Coverage
zone_crossing_alert_coverage.description: Describes the extent to which alerting rules are configured specifically for zone-crossing events at protocol-layer transitions into local storage.

shared_api_per_entity_segmentation.title: Per-Entity Segmentation on Shared Boundary API
shared_api_per_entity_segmentation.description: Indicates whether the shared boundary interface or API enforces per-entity segmentation, preventing one external entity from accessing paths or zones intended for another.

boundary_interface_access_control_model.title: Boundary Interface Access Control Model
boundary_interface_access_control_model.description: Describes the access control model enforced at the shared boundary interface for external entities.

internal_zone_reachable_from_shared_inte.title: Internal Zones Reachable via Shared Interface
internal_zone_reachable_from_shared_inte.description: Indicates whether traversal from the shared boundary interface can reach internal storage zones or subzones beyond the immediate boundary.

egress_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Egress Rate Limiting Enabled
egress_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether rate limiting or bandwidth/volume throttling controls are enforced on data egress at the storage zone boundary.

egress_volume_threshold_configured.title: Egress Volume Threshold Configured
egress_volume_threshold_configured.description: Whether a maximum egress volume threshold is defined and enforced to trigger alerts or blocks when exceeded.

egress_anomaly_detection_enabled.title: Egress Anomaly Detection Enabled
egress_anomaly_detection_enabled.description: Whether behavioral anomaly detection is active on egress traffic patterns at the storage zone boundary to flag statistically unusual transfer rates or volumes.

storage_boundary_audit_enabled.title: Storage Boundary Audit Enabled
storage_boundary_audit_enabled.description: Whether periodic audits of the local storage zone boundary definition (mounts, attached paths, accessible directories) are actively performed and enforced.

unapproved_mount_count.title: Unapproved Mount Points Present
unapproved_mount_count.description: Number of mount points or attached paths currently active in the local storage zone that are not present in the approved boundary definition baseline.

boundary_controls_applied_to_new_mounts.title: Boundary Controls Applied to New Mounts
boundary_controls_applied_to_new_mounts.description: Whether ingress/egress filtering and access controls equivalent to the original zone boundary controls are automatically applied to newly added mount points or attached paths.

physical_port_access_controls_enabled.title: Physical Port Access Controls Enabled
physical_port_access_controls_enabled.description: Indicates whether physical storage ports and removable media interfaces are disabled, locked, or otherwise access-controlled to prevent unauthorized use.

removable_media_mount_policy.title: Removable Media Mount Policy
removable_media_mount_policy.description: Describes the policy governing whether removable media can be mounted by the operating system on the local storage host.

physical_interface_activity_logged.title: Physical Interface Activity Logged
physical_interface_activity_logged.description: Indicates whether attachment and access events on physical storage interfaces are captured in audit logs.
